description: This file defines the SystemTargetPlacementStrategy class, which represents a placement strategy used specifically by system targets within the Orleans framework. It includes a singleton instance and overrides a property indicating its usage of a grain directory.

classes.name: SystemTargetPlacementStrategy
classes.description: A sealed class implementing a placement strategy for system targets, inheriting from PlacementStrategy. It uses attributes for serialization and immutability, and provides a singleton instance.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: A static property that returns the singleton instance of SystemTargetPlacementStrategy.

methods.name: IsUsingGrainDirectory
methods.description: An overridden property indicating whether this strategy uses a grain directory; returns false.
